title: APOTHEOSIS PARADOX - GHOST ARENA
author: ChuChunBoy
selftext:
This is my autobattler game, you can play it freely on itch.io. I am developing it alone. Give it a watch, i feel like i did a nice job with the video. I hope you like it. I spent several months developing it using ai, its a html web based game.  
This is where you can play it. [Apotheosis Paradox - Ghost Arena(Autobattler) by Swordle-SSS-wordsmaN](https://swordle-sss-wordsman.itch.io/versus) 

It's not perfect, i am not professional and needs work in some places. Some things might not work properly. But most of it is working fine, especially the multiple modes such as knockout, standard, and the evolution modes, which are the ones i am guessing most people will play. Story mode is working but a bit rough. Regardless, you can give it a try, theres fun to be had if you play a few rounds. Evolution modes are very fun as you can become extremely powerful.

comments.author: jeffersonianMI
comments.body:
I think this might do well if you stick to either hardcore fantasy art or icons art.   Logically what you are doing makes sense.   I found the mix jarring, though I'm unfamiliar with the genre and maybe old. 

My instinct is that some version of the fantasy art would be superior if you could maintain visual distinction (might be hard).  This would probably require some reading on character design, or some similar topic.  The great thing about icons is that they're often really good at this just the way they are.  I read some great stuff about League of Legends struggling with exactly this issue of unit distinction.  StarCraft was also aware of it.
